categories.name: Wrapped-Tokens
categories.content: Wrapped tokens offer a way to circumvent the lack of interoperability between different blockchains. The wrapping of a token happens when the original asset is put into a “wrapper” and deployed on a different blockchain. With it being wrapped, the cryptocurrency can now be used on a blockchain where it previously wasn’t available. One example of a wrapped token would be Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC). It is an ERC-20 version of Bitcoin, which allows it to be used on protocols based on Ethereum. Watch this video to learn more about Wrapped tokens.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Layer 3 (L3)
categories.content: Layer 3 protocols are built on Layer 2, enabling hosting of application-specific decentralized applications while addressing issues such as scalability, interoperability and customization.

categories.name: Healthcare
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the healthcare industry.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Bridged DAI
categories.content: Bridged DAI refers to DAI that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging'.

categories.name: Bridged Stablecoin
categories.content: Bridged stablecoin refers to a stablecoin that has been transferred, or “bridged,” from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: Ondo Intelligent Portfolios
categories.content: Single-token portfolio products issued by Ondo Finance that bundle multiple tokenized assets into one on-chain instrument. Each portfolio packages a themed basket that is drawn from Ondo's tokenized equities, ETFs, and in some cases crypto assets.

categories.name: Fighting Games

categories.name: Discord Bots
categories.content: Discord bots are tools that automate tasks to the Discord server, making them more engaging and interactive for users.

categories.content: Solana Token-2022 is a new token standard on Solana that provides additional fungible and non-fungible token functionality.
